extracted.intended_audience: TCU students, library patrons, and anyone seeking award-winning young adult literature
extracted.subtask_description: A university library guide listing Michael L. Printz Award winners and honor books, with bibliographic details and availability at TCU. Useful for locating critically recognized young adult (YA) literature defined by the Printz Award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literary excellence in young adult literature (Printz Award standard)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Michael L. Printz Award is an award for a book that exemplifies literary excellence in young adult literature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sponsored by Booklist (a publication of the American Library Association) and named for librarian Michael L. Printz. The page lists Printz Medal winners and Printz Honor books by year with bibliographic details (title, author, ISBN, publication date) and short descriptive annotations for many entries—these listed titles serve as examples of the award’s standard of literary excellence. Link to ALA YALSA Printz Award page: http://www.ala.org/yalsa/printz-award

rubrics_metrics.name: Medal vs Honor designation (level of recognition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Printz recognitions are presented as a Medal (the award winner) or Honor(s) (distinguished runners-up).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guide identifies which titles received the Printz Medal and which received Printz Honor in each year (e.g., The Collectors: Stories — Printz Medal, 2024; Fire from the Sky — Printz Honor, 2024). The library’s list groups and labels books by their Medal/Honor status and year, which can be used to prioritize or filter recommendations.
